# The tools that build the documentation site (mkdocs.yml). Pinned, so that a new release cannot break the site unannounced; update them
# on purpose.
#
# Material for MkDocs is in maintenance mode (its authors develop the successor, Zensical, which reads the same mkdocs.yml); it still
# receives fixes. Revisit when that changes. Stay on MkDocs 1.x: according to the Material team, MkDocs 2.0 removes the plugin and theme
# systems that Material (and the hook in this folder) rely on.
mkdocs==1.6.1
mkdocs-material==9.7.7
